name: Sync Market Pro
author: WPRealizer

sections.description:
Sync Market Pro is a robust WooCommerce plugin designed to streamline the process of syncing products, inventory, and orders across major online marketplaces. With seamless integration to platforms like Amazon, TikTok, Walmart, and more, Sync Market Pro helps you manage your multi-channel sales from a central location — your WooCommerce store.

Say goodbye to manual updates and stock discrepancies. Sync Market Pro offers real-time synchronization of product listings, inventory updates, and order management to keep your marketplaces in sync, reducing errors and improving operational efficiency. Whether you’re a solo seller or managing a large eCommerce business, Sync Market Pro makes everything easier.

Key Features:
1. Multi-Channel Integration: Sync products, orders, and inventory across Amazon, TikTok, and Walmart
2. Real-time Inventory Sync: Automatic stock level updates across all platforms
3. Bulk Product Upload: Upload multiple products at once to save time
4. Order Management: Centralized order processing from all marketplaces
5. Price Sync: Keep your prices consistent across all platforms
6. Automated Updates: Set it and forget it – automatic syncing of all changes

Why Choose Sync Market Pro?

  • Eliminate the hassle of managing inventory and products manually on multiple platforms.
  • Enhance order processing efficiency with automated updates.
  • Centralize all marketplace sales and orders directly in your WooCommerce dashboard.

Third-Party Service Dependency

This plugin relies on the following third-party services to provide certain functionalities. By using Sync Market Pro, you acknowledge the following:

  • Service Availability: The functionality of this plugin is dependent on the availability and performance of the TikTok Shop API and Walmart API. Service interruptions or delays from these external services may affect the plugin’s performance.
  • Account Requirement: To use Sync Market Pro, you must have an active account with TikTok Shop API and Walmart API. You are responsible for complying with their terms of service and privacy policy.
  • Data Handling: The plugin may transmit data to and from TikTok Shop API and Walmart API. You are responsible for ensuring that you have the proper rights to transmit data and comply with applicable data privacy laws.

External Service Links:
– TikTok Shop API
Privacy Policy: https://www.tiktok.com/legal/page/row/privacy-policy/en
API Endpoint: https://tiktokshopapi.com/connect

  • TikTok Global Shop API
    Privacy Policy: https://www.tiktok.com/legal/page/row/privacy-policy/en
    API Endpoint: https://open-api.tiktokglobalshop.com/product/202309/products

  • Walmart Marketplace API
    Privacy Policy: https://commerce.walmart.com/content/walmart-commerce-tech/en_us/privacy-policy.html
    API Endpoint: https://marketplace.walmartapis.com/v3/token

  • Walmart Sandbox API
    Privacy Policy: https://commerce.walmart.com/content/walmart-commerce-tech/en_us/privacy-policy.html
    API Endpoint: https://sandbox.walmartapis.com/v3/feeds?feedType=MP_ITEM

  • Walmart Item API
    Privacy Policy: https://commerce.walmart.com/content/walmart-commerce-tech/en_us/privacy-policy.html
    API Endpoint: http://walmart.com/mp/v3/item

  • Sync Market Pro API
    Terms of Service: https://syncmarketpro.com/services
    API Endpoint: https://syncmarketpro.com/middleware/api.php?state=

Privacy Policy

Your privacy is important to us. This plugin may collect, use, and store personal information as described in our Privacy Policy. Please review the policy to understand how your data is handled.

For more information, please visit our Privacy Policy: https://syncmarketpro.com/privacy-policy/

Donate

If Sync Market Pro helps you manage your online business more efficiently, consider donating to support its continued development: [Your Donation Link]
sections.installation:
1. Download and install Sync Market Pro from the WordPress plugin repository or upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/sync-market-pro via FTP.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to Sync Market Pro Settings and connect your Amazon, TikTok, Walmart, or other marketplace accounts.
  4. Configure your synchronization settings, and let Sync Market Pro handle the rest!
sections.faq:
Q: Does Sync Market Pro support other marketplaces?
Yes! In addition to Amazon, TikTok, and Walmart, Sync Market Pro supports many other popular marketplaces, and we continue to add new platforms regularly.

Q: How does real-time inventory synchronization work?
Sync Market Pro automatically updates inventory levels across all connected platforms as soon as a sale is made, ensuring stock levels are always accurate and preventing overselling.

Q: Can I manage orders from all marketplaces in WooCommerce?
Yes, all marketplace orders are synced directly to your WooCommerce dashboard, making it easy to manage everything in one place.

Q: Is there a limit on the number of products or orders I can sync?
Sync Market Pro supports an unlimited number of products and orders. For large stores, we recommend optimized hosting for the best performance.
